meta.name: build
meta.description: Workflow orchestrator that chains existing skills for feature development

copy.tagline: 串联已有技能，自动执行功能开发流程
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要按顺序调用多个技能来完成开发任务
copy.tagline_en: Chain existing skills to automate feature development workflows
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to call multiple skills in sequence for development tasks

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 能根据你的需求自动编排多个技能（如调研、规划、编码、提交）来开发功能。它会按顺序执行这些步骤，并在关键节点暂停让你检查。
howto.when: 当你输入 /build 命令并选择工作流模式（如新功能、改造代码、测试驱动开发）时触发。如果只输入 /build 不带参数，Claude 会通过一系列问题帮你确定配置。

say.text: /build greenfield 添加用户登录功能
/build tdd 实现购物车结算功能
say.note: 采用测试驱动开发模式，先写测试再实现。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can orchestrate multiple skills (e.g., research, plan, code, commit) in sequence to develop features. It pauses at phase boundaries for human review.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you type /build and select a workflow mode (e.g., greenfield, brownfield, TDD). If you type /build without arguments, Claude asks questions to determine the configuration.

say_en.note: Starts a new feature workflow with discovery, plan, validate, implement, commit.
Works on existing codebase, skipping validation phase.
Uses test-driven development: write tests first, then implement.
